entities.summary: The Uppsala Mosque is a small but very frequented mosque located in the Kapellgärdet neighbourhood of Uppsala in Sweden. At the time of construction, it was mistakenly claimed to be the northernmost mosque in the world. It is still the northernmost mosque in Sweden.
